codeSnippet:
let mut v: Vec<i32> = Vec::new();
v.push(1);

explanation.en: let mut, Vec<i32> and push are hallmark Rust syntax.
explanation.ar: let mut وVec<i32> وpush من سمات لغة Rust.

explanation.en: package main with func main and fmt.Println is idiomatic Go.
explanation.ar: package main مع func main وfmt.Println من ملامح Go.

codeSnippet: interface User { id: number; name: string; }

explanation.en: interface with typed fields is TypeScript, not plain JavaScript.
explanation.ar: interface بحقول مُنمّطة هي TypeScript وليست JavaScript عادية.

explanation.en: fun and val with println are Kotlin markers.
explanation.ar: fun وval مع println من علامات Kotlin.

codeSnippet:
let names = ["a", "b"]
for n in names { print(n) }

explanation.en: let arrays with this for-in and print are Swift.
explanation.ar: مصفوفات let مع حلقة for-in وprint هي Swift.

explanation.en: Integer#times with a block and puts is classic Ruby.
explanation.ar: الطريقة times مع كتلة وputs من كلاسيكيات Ruby.

explanation.en: The <?php tag and $ variables are unmistakably PHP.
explanation.ar: وسم <?php ومتغيرات $ تدل بوضوح على PHP.

codeSnippet: SELECT name FROM users WHERE age > 18;

explanation.en: SELECT ... FROM ... WHERE is core SQL.
explanation.ar: SELECT ... FROM ... WHERE من صميم SQL.

codeSnippet: for f in *.txt; do echo "$f"; done

explanation.en: for f in *.txt; do ... done with $f is a Bash loop.
explanation.ar: for f in *.txt; do ... done مع $f حلقة Bash.

explanation.en: List<string> and Console.WriteLine are C# .NET.
explanation.ar: List<string> وConsole.WriteLine من C#/‏.NET.

explanation.en: std::cout and std::endl with <iostream> are C++.
explanation.ar: std::cout وstd::endl مع <iostream> هي C++.

explanation.en: printf with format specifiers and stdio.h is plain C.
explanation.ar: printf مع محدّدات التنسيق وstdio.h هي C خالصة.

explanation.en: System.out.println is the Java print idiom.
explanation.ar: System.out.println هي طريقة الطباعة في Java.

explanation.en: const with an arrow-function map (no types) is JavaScript.
explanation.ar: const مع map ودالة سهمية دون أنواع هي JavaScript.

explanation.en: A list comprehension with range is distinctly Python.
explanation.ar: اشتقاق القوائم مع range مميز في Python.

explanation.en: match with Some/None over an Option is Rust pattern matching.
explanation.ar: match مع Some/None على Option هي مطابقة أنماط Rust.

codeSnippet:
ch := make(chan int)
go func() { ch <- 1 }()

explanation.en: make(chan int) and go func with <- are Go concurrency.
explanation.ar: make(chan int) وgo func مع <- من تزامن Go.

codeSnippet: function id<T>(x: T): T { return x; }

explanation.en: A generic <T> with typed params and return is TypeScript.
explanation.ar: دالة عامة <T> بأنواع للمعاملات والإرجاع هي TypeScript.

codeSnippet: guard let user = maybeUser else { return }

explanation.en: guard let ... else is Swift's optional-unwrapping idiom.
explanation.ar: guard let ... else هي صيغة فك الاختياري في Swift.

explanation.en: The #!/bin/bash shebang and [ -f ] test are Bash.
explanation.ar: بادئة #!/bin/bash واختبار [ -f ] من Bash.
